# README banner

`banner.jpg` is the picture at the top of the README. It was generated locally with Z-Image Turbo (bf16) in ComfyUI: 1536x640, 9 steps, cfg 1.0, sampler res_multistep, scheduler simple, seed 1567283165, then resized to 1280x533 and saved as JPEG. The same prompt and seed give the same picture.

Prompt:

> a happy golden retriever dog carrying a rolled paper scroll in its mouth, trotting out of a tall stack of question cards in a cozy study, wide cinematic banner illustration, painterly digital art, soft volumetric light, rich but muted colour palette, detailed, storybook atmosphere, no text, no letters, no words, no logos, no watermark
